spans.s:
r. 5th cl. (रिणोति)
To hurt or injure.
r. 6th cl. (रियति)
To go, to move.

m. (रिः)
1 The tone of voice by which the note Ṛṣabha is uttered.
2 Dancing, tumbling.
3 Waste, loss.
f. (रिः)
Wish, desire.
4 Light, lustre.
E.
रा to give, &c. aff. कि.

r. 9th cl. (रीणाति)
1 To hurt, to injure.
2 To go, to move.
3 To howl, as a wild beast.
(ङ) रीङ् r. 4th cl. (रीयते)
1 To distil, to ooze, to drop.
2 To fall, to alight.
r. 2nd cl. (रेति)
To bear or conceive, (as a child.)
